test_title: PYST 23: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - Reasoning (Held On: 19th Sep 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Which of the following words is formed by changing exactly one letter at one place in the word INVENTION?
solution:
Given word: INVENTION

**(1) INTENTION → Can be formed by changing on letter "N" to "T".**

(2) RETENTION → Can not be form by changing only one letter.

(3) ATTENTION → Can not be form by changing only one letter.

(4) DETENTION → Can not be form by changing only one letter.

Hence, the correct answer is “**Option 1**”.
